{{Attr|Aggro}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Corrupted Revenant''' was an tanky enemy that appeared in the [[Nil Zone]] as part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]]. It can currently only be accessed through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. While slower than the [[Corrupted Wraith]], it had higher health and defense, which made it far stronger than it. It would also occasionally spawn with attributes like [[Aggro]]. ==Appearance== The '''Corrupted Revenant''' has a dark red skin and it is faceless. On its torso, it has a large hole which reveals its ribcage and the purple substance that is inside its body. It wears grey shoulder-pads and grey belt. On its shoulder-pads, it has red crystals. On its arms, it has large grey claws. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Nil Zone]] is listed instead. *Towers like the [[Engineer]], [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Golden Soldier]] can be used to take this down. **AOE Towers like the [[Rocketeer]] or [[Mortar]] are also useful at dealing with multiple of them at once, which is especially helpful when they spawn with [[Aggro]]. *Stalling towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Freezer]] and [[Toxic Gunner]] can be quite effective against the '''Corrupted Revenant''', as they can both stall it and decrease its defense, making it easier to deal with. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.1.0GenericThumbnail6.png|'''Corrupted Revenant''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseCorruptedRevenant.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CorruptedRevenantIconIG.png|'''Corrupted Revenant''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Corrupted Revenant''' is a corrupted version of the [[Hex Revenant]] from the [[Hexscape Event]], except with its heart and glowing eyes removed. *The '''Corrupted Revenant''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''4 October 2025''' -
